tools.name: list_archetypes
tools.description: List all synthetic household archetypes (id, name, life stage, wealth tier, household type).

tools.name: list_bundles
tools.description: List product bundles (themed household datasets) with use cases and one-time-purchase links.

tools.name: get_sample_household
tools.description: Get one deliberately-insufficient sample household (PII removed, dollar amounts banded, 96-month trajectory truncated to 12 months, projections withheld). Free sample archetypes: F-01, A-01, H-01, H-02, S-01, R-01, RE-01, RL-01. Other archetypes are in the paid corpus.

tools.name: describe_household_schema
tools.description: Describe the top-level fields of a synthetic household record.

tools.name: get_purchase_link
tools.description: Get the one-time-purchase product URL for a bundle.

tools.name: list_reference_parameters
tools.description: List the U.S. federal financial-planning parameters for a tax year (keys, labels, domains), marking which are in the free sample. Optionally filter by domain.

tools.name: get_reference_parameter
tools.description: Get a source-verified U.S. federal financial-planning parameter by key and tax year, with its value and primary-source citation. Without a paid key, only the headline free-sample figures return values.

tools.name: get_planning_benchmark
tools.description: Get Planning Benchmark v2 - 50 free evaluation tasks for AI financial-advice systems with answer keys by construction: required figures cited to primary source documents, wrong-but-plausible stale values enumerated with reason codes (the Stale Figure Rate metric). Pass blind=true to omit the answer
